Variants.Content: The Shadow Tower is located at the west end of the Wall, near a dangerous area where mountains and forests intersect. It is one of the three main castles in Night's Watch. It faces not the harbor of Eastwatch, but narrow mountain roads, steep slopes and paths leading to the west beyond the wall. The weather, rocks, and snow on the west end make patrolling particularly difficult; a seemingly unused trail can suddenly become a passage during spring melt or fighting. The high walls, lookout towers, stables and grain storage areas of the Shadow Tower serve the patrols and vigilance of Night's Watch. It is not an ordinary vassal castle.
Entry Shadow Tower Local families also rely on frozen soil, firewood, seal meat, supply convoys and long vigils; if any road, well or dock fails, the price falls first on them.

Entry Shadow Tower If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

From workshops to sanctuaries, Shadow Tower juxtaposes stone walls, wooden beams, iron doors, tombs and seams left by generations of repairs with Night's Watch oaths, old gods and memories of the dead in the shadow of the Wall. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Shadow Tower They care about frozen soil, firewood, seal meat, supply convoys and long vigils. They also look at whether seeds are left after the food collection and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see the coat of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
